svg.title: Test the mail rule and an ordinary message
svg.desc: A receipt should gain a tag. Ordinary mail should keep its original subject. Check both before closing the case. Predict. Write down what each new test message should look like. Observe. Send the practice receipt and ordinary message. Read both subjects. Decide. A tagged receipt and an unchanged ordinary message support the fix for these two cases.
